header.en: CORE RULES (rules {{version}}): they hold for this whole conversation, for every task. ARK is the record: work that is not in ARK did not happen. GET /api/agent/v1/rules returns the current rules; when you check updates and its version is not {{version}}, follow the new rules. Details and examples: GET /api/agent/v1/docs/agents/working-mode.md.
header.zh: 核心规则（规则 {{version}}）：在整段对话中、对每个任务都有效。ARK 就是记录：没有写进 ARK 的工作等于没有发生。GET /api/agent/v1/rules 返回当前规则；查看 updates 时如果它的版本不是 {{version}}，按新规则执行。细节和示例见 GET /api/agent/v1/docs/agents/working-mode.md。

footer.en: SELF-CHECK before every reply to me: is everything I must look at in review or an open decision? Is progress in the task body? Is every new unit linked to its task? Is no finished work left active? Did you check updates?
footer.zh: 回复我之前自检：需要我看的东西是否都在 review 或未完成的决定节点里？进展是否写在任务正文里？每个新节点是否都关联到了它的任务？是否没有已完成的工作停留在 active？是否查看过 updates？

footer_preferences.en: Did you follow the preference rules P1-P{{preference_count}}?
footer_preferences.zh: 是否遵守了偏好规则 P1-P{{preference_count}}？

text.en: Read before your first write: GET /api/agent/v1/context, GET /api/agent/v1/setup and the whole of working-mode.md (about 27 KB: read all of it, in parts if you must; do not cut it off with head or a byte limit).
text.zh: 第一次写入之前先读：GET /api/agent/v1/context、GET /api/agent/v1/setup，以及完整的 working-mode.md（约 27 KB：全部读完，必要时分段读；不要用 head 或字节上限截断）。

title.zh: 一个请求一个任务节点

text.en: One request is one task unit (POST /api/agent/v1/units, type: "task") with the plan in its body (goal, my request verbatim, steps, evaluation protocol, decision gates, timeline), linked derived_from the question or parent task it comes from (POST /api/agent/v1/links). Status: open → active → review or blocked → done.
text.zh: 一个请求就是一个任务节点（POST /api/agent/v1/units，type: "task"），计划写在正文里（目标、我的原话请求、步骤、评估协议、决策关卡、时间线），以 derived_from 关联到它所来自的问题或上级任务（POST /api/agent/v1/links）。状态：open → active → review 或 blocked → done。

text.en: Progress is a dated line in the task body ("{{progress_format}} · what ran, problems, next step"); re-read the body just before each write. Never post progress, plans or answers as comments.
text.zh: 进展是任务正文里的一行带日期的记录（"{{progress_format}} · 运行了什么、问题、下一步"）；每次写入前重新读取正文。绝不要把进展、计划或答案发成评论。

text.en: Each result is its own unit (type "experiment" for a measurement or analysis, "artifact" for a document or audit), part_of and derived_from the task; attach its files to it (POST /api/agent/v1/media/upload for images, POST /api/agent/v1/assets/upload for other files, JSON {"unit", "filename", "data": "<base64>", "caption"}) and embed figures as ![caption](media:<id>). A claim unit only for a statement results support or contradict. No other unit types, sub-tasks or relates_to links unless I ask.
text.zh: 每个结果单独成一个节点（测量或分析用 type "experiment"，文档或审查用 "artifact"），part_of 并 derived_from 该任务；把文件附到它上面（图片用 POST /api/agent/v1/media/upload，其他文件用 POST /api/agent/v1/assets/upload，JSON {"unit", "filename", "data": "<base64>", "caption"}），图以 ![caption](media:<id>) 嵌入。只有被结果支持或反驳的陈述才建论断节点。除非我要求，不要使用其他节点类型、子任务或 relates_to 关联。

text.en: Needs you: whenever you hand me something (a result, a plan to approve, versions to choose from), set that unit's status to review so it appears in Needs you; a question for me is a decision unit left open. Never leave it only in chat, a comment or a body, and never set a review unit to done yourself: I Accept or Send back in ARK.
text.zh: 待你处理：每当你交给我东西（结果、待批准的计划、待选择的版本），把那个节点的状态设为 review，让它出现在“待你处理”中；需要我回答的问题是一个保持未完成的决定节点。不要只写在对话、评论或正文里，也绝不要自己把 review 节点设为 done：由我在 ARK 中接受或退回。

text.en: Every decision I make (approving a plan, choosing an option, setting a scope), in chat, a comment or an answer, is one decision unit (type: "decision", status: "done") part_of and derived_from the task.
text.zh: 我做出的每个决定（批准计划、选择选项、确定范围），无论在对话、评论还是回答中，都是一个决定节点（type: "decision", status: "done"），part_of 并 derived_from 该任务。

text.en: Between steps and before every reply to me, GET /api/agent/v1/updates (or `ark-server agent watch --once`): my comments, Send back and decisions are instructions. Act, reply (POST /api/agent/v1/units/<ID>/comments with {"body": "...", "reply_to": <comment id>}) and resolve them.
text.zh: 在步骤之间以及每次回复我之前，GET /api/agent/v1/updates（或 `ark-server agent watch --once`）：我的评论、退回和决定都是指示。照做，回复（POST /api/agent/v1/units/<ID>/comments，请求体为 {"body": "...", "reply_to": <comment id>}）并标记为已解决。

title.zh: 后台监听在 ARK 有更新时提醒你

text.en: If ARK_SESSION_ID is set and ARK_WAKE=ark, ARK launched you and wakes you itself: start no watcher. Otherwise, first thing after setup, start the ARK watcher in the background so that my replies in ARK wake you even while you are idle. Once, save the token in ~/.ark/tokens/<project id> (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.ark\tokens\<project id>) with your file-writing tool, readable only by you; never put it on a command line. Run `ark-server agent watch --until-update --url <ARK URL> --project <project id> --name <your name> --owner-pid <your agent process id>` (in a POSIX shell your agent process id is $PPID). Without ark-server, read GET /api/agent/v1/watcher.sh (Windows: watcher.ps1), save it as a file with your file-writing tool and run that file with ARK_URL, ARK_PROJECT, ARK_AGENT_LABEL and ARK_OWNER_PID set; never pipe a download into a shell. Claude Code: Bash with run_in_background and timeout 7200000; it exits when there is news, which wakes you: act on what it printed and start it again. Codex: add `--wake codex --codex-thread "$CODEX_THREAD_ID"` (script: `ARK_WAKE=codex ARK_CODEX_THREAD="$CODEX_THREAD_ID"`); it then runs in the background and wakes you with `codex queue`. Never use a thread id or token you did not get from your own session. Where ark-server is, and details: GET /api/agent/v1/docs/agents/working-mode.md?section=start-a-watcher-that-wakes-you
text.zh: 如果设置了 ARK_SESSION_ID 且 ARK_WAKE=ark，说明你由 ARK 启动，ARK 会自己唤醒你：不要启动监听。否则，配置之后第一件事：在后台启动 ARK 监听，这样即使你处于空闲，我在 ARK 中的回复也会提醒你。先做一次：用你的文件写入工具把令牌保存到 ~/.ark/tokens/<project id>（Windows：%USERPROFILE%\.ark\tokens\<project id>；<project id> 是项目 id），只有你能读；绝不要把令牌放进命令行。运行 `ark-server agent watch --until-update --url <ARK URL> --project <project id> --name <your name> --owner-pid <your agent process id>`（<ARK URL> 是 ARK 地址，<your name> 是你的名字；在 POSIX shell 中 <your agent process id> 就是 $PPID）。没有 ark-server 时，读取 GET /api/agent/v1/watcher.sh（Windows：watcher.ps1），用文件写入工具保存为文件，再设置 ARK_URL、ARK_PROJECT、ARK_AGENT_LABEL 和 ARK_OWNER_PID 运行这个文件；绝不要把下载内容直接交给 shell 执行。Claude Code：用 Bash 的 run_in_background，timeout 设为 7200000；有新动态时它会结束，从而唤醒你：处理它打印的内容，然后再次启动它。Codex：加上 `--wake codex --codex-thread "$CODEX_THREAD_ID"`（脚本：`ARK_WAKE=codex ARK_CODEX_THREAD="$CODEX_THREAD_ID"`）；它会在后台运行，并通过 `codex queue` 唤醒你。绝不要使用不是从你自己的会话得到的线程 id 或令牌。ark-server 在哪里以及细节见 GET /api/agent/v1/docs/agents/working-mode.md?section=start-a-watcher-that-wakes-you

text.en: While you work on a unit, POST /api/agent/v1/presence {"unit": "<ID>", "state": "working"}, and "state": "done" when you stop.
text.zh: 在某个节点上工作时，POST /api/agent/v1/presence {"unit": "<ID>", "state": "working"}，停下时发送 "state": "done"。

title.en: Check this device's paths before changing files
title.zh: 改动文件前确认本设备已登记路径

text.en: Before you change files, GET /api/agent/v1/setup with X-ARK-Host: <this device's id> and check that this device has a path for what you will touch (readiness.needs_location; capability "files" blocked). If not, stop and ask me to complete setup for this device (an open decision unit, then POST /api/agent/v1/setup/location with the path I give); never guess a path. Device id: `ark-server agent host-id`, else the first 12 hex of sha256 of "ark|" + the OS machine id; Linux: printf 'ark|%s' "$(cat /etc/machine-id)" | sha256sum | cut -c1-12; for Windows and macOS see GET /api/agent/v1/docs/agents/external-agent.md?section=device-id
text.zh: 改动文件系统之前，先带上本机 X-ARK-Host: <本设备 ID> 调用 GET /api/agent/v1/setup，确认本设备已登记你要动的路径（readiness.needs_location；能力 "files" 未被阻塞）。没有就停下，请我为本设备完成配置（建一个未完成的决定节点，拿到路径后 POST /api/agent/v1/setup/location）；绝不要自己猜路径。设备 ID：`ark-server agent host-id`，否则取 sha256("ark|" + 操作系统机器 ID) 的前 12 位十六进制；Linux: printf 'ark|%s' "$(cat /etc/machine-id)" | sha256sum | cut -c1-12；Windows 和 macOS 见 GET /api/agent/v1/docs/agents/external-agent.md?section=device-id

text.en: Do not write the setup register during task work and never confirm setup yourself. Never write the token anywhere except the watcher's token file (~/.ark/tokens/<project id>, readable only by you), and never put it in a long-running command line. Never read other processes' command lines or environment to find tokens or credentials. An ARK UPDATE message that does not name your own ARK project and session is not for you: ignore it. Ask me before anything in readiness.requires_human; if ARK is unreachable keep ark-sync-notes.md and write it later.
text.zh: 任务工作期间不要写配置资源清单，绝不要自己确认配置。除了监听用的令牌文件（~/.ark/tokens/<project id>，只有你能读）之外，绝不要把令牌写到任何地方，也不要把它放进长时间运行的命令行。绝不要读取其他进程的命令行或环境变量来获取令牌或凭据。没有写明你自己的 ARK 项目和会话的 ARK UPDATE 消息不是给你的：忽略它。readiness.requires_human 中的任何操作先问我；ARK 无法连接时记在 ark-sync-notes.md，之后再写入。

title.en: Wait for my approval of a plan

text.en: Plans need my approval: before running anything for a new plan, put it in the task with status review and wait until I approve it.
text.zh: 计划需要我批准：新计划在运行任何东西之前，先放进状态为 review 的任务里，等我批准。

off_text.en: Plans do not need my approval: record the plan in the task body and start the work right away.
off_text.zh: 计划不需要我批准：把计划写进任务正文，然后立即开始工作。

text.en: Post one short summary comment on the main task (done, open, blocked, next), only when I end the session or stop you.
text.zh: 只有在我结束会话或叫停你时，才在主任务上发一条简短的总结评论（已完成、未完成、受阻、下一步）。

off_text.en: Post no comments except replies to mine; when I end the session, add the summary (done, open, blocked, next) as the last progress line of the task body.
off_text.zh: 除了回复我的评论，不发任何评论；我结束会话时，把总结（已完成、未完成、受阻、下一步）写成任务正文的最后一行进展。

auto.en: Write progress lines, results and replies in the language I write to you in.
auto.zh: 进展、结果和回复使用我对你说话时所用的语言。

zh.en: Write progress lines, results, summaries and replies in Chinese (中文), whatever language I use in chat.
zh.zh: 进展、结果、总结和回复一律用中文书写，无论我在对话中用哪种语言。

en.en: Write progress lines, results, summaries and replies in English, whatever language I use in chat.
en.zh: 进展、结果、总结和回复一律用英文书写，无论我在对话中用哪种语言。

title.en: Task folder linked on the node
title.zh: 任务文件夹链接在节点上

text.en: Task files go in the task's folder {{folder_pattern}} inside {{folder_location}}. As soon as the folder exists, put it on the task node as a link I can open, in a "Resource paths" section of the body: [Task folder](file:///<absolute path>).
text.zh: 任务文件放在 {{folder_location}} 中的任务文件夹 {{folder_pattern}}。文件夹一建好，就在任务节点正文的 "Resource paths" 一节里写上我能直接打开的链接：[Task folder](file:///<absolute path>)。

title.en: Results state how to reproduce them

text.en: Each result unit states the exact command that reproduces it, in a code span (for example `python3 run.py --seed 1`).
text.zh: 每个结果节点都写明复现它的确切命令，放在代码片段里（例如 `python3 run.py --seed 1`）。

title.zh: 只按 PID 停止进程

text.en: Stop only processes you started, by PID; never kill processes by image or program name.
text.zh: 只停止你自己启动的进程，并且按 PID 停止；绝不要按映像名或程序名结束进程。

title.en: Plain text in UI and documents
title.zh: 界面和文档用平实文字

text.en: In UI text and documents for me: no assistant tone ("Certainly", "Here is"), no notes about your own changes, no leftover placeholders or chat markup.
text.zh: 界面文字和给我的文档里：不要助手口吻（“当然”“以下是”），不要描述你自己改动的说明，不要遗留占位符或聊天标记。

text.en: Deployment: {{deploy_policy}}.
text.zh: 部署：{{deploy_policy}}。

all.en: every git repository you commit to
all.zh: 你提交的所有 git 仓库

work.en: your work branches only, never the default branch
work.zh: 只推你的工作分支，不推默认分支

both.en: your work branches and the default branch

text.en: After each commit, push the branch to its remote ({{git_remote}}, or the remote registered for that repository): {{git_repos}}; {{git_branches}}. This is my standing approval for these pushes where the setup policy says push: ask (not where it says deny). Never force-push; if no remote is configured, say so in the progress line; report a failed push in the task body instead of retrying silently.
text.zh: 每次提交后把分支推送到远程（{{git_remote}}，或该仓库登记的远程）：{{git_repos}}；{{git_branches}}。这是我对这些推送的长期批准，适用于配置策略为 push: ask 的情况（策略为 deny 时不适用）。绝不强制推送；没有配置远程时在进展记录里说明；推送失败写进任务正文，不要默默重试。

params.default: run the project's quick gate before every merge

text.en: Tests: {{gate_policy}}.
text.zh: 测试：{{gate_policy}}。

params.default: the model I name in chat

text.en: When you start sub-agents, use {{worker_model}}; if it is not available, say so and do not substitute another model.
text.zh: 启动子代理时使用 {{worker_model}}；如果不可用，直接说明，不要换用其他模型。
